title: SurtitleLive Product Updates
description: Weekly SurtitleLive product updates, grouped by release version, with concise notes on new features, improvements and user-visible fixes.

versions.summary: This release adds manual accessibility captions and improves live updates, transcript downloads, and account controls.
versions.imageAlt: Editor line-type menu with Accessibility caption selected and the example [Doorbell rings in background].
new: Added manual accessibility captions in the Editor. They appear as bracketed cues in simulations, projections, and audience views.
improved: Made live subtitle updates more reliable across connected screens, with better recovery when delivery is interrupted.
Improved audience-view recovery after reconnects and session changes.
Simplified live-session transcript downloads into a CSV with time, original text, and translation columns, while preserving distinct corrections.
Clarified that Access Passes purchased in the Pockitle app must be extended in the app.
Improved the account-deletion flow so users can review or cancel a pending request after signing out.
fixed: Fixed live stage directions being wrapped in extra parentheses.

versions.summary: This release restored localized Pockitle entry points and expanded the promoted public-language experience.
new: Added Brazilian Portuguese public pages and planning content to the localized Pockitle experience.
improved: Restored the locale-specific Get started action on Pockitle Live pages and corrected localized public navigation.

versions.summary: This release expanded account controls and improved preparation before a live session.
new: Expanded Account settings with identity details, password-reset access, legal-consent review, sign-out-all-devices controls, and account-deletion status or cancellation.
improved: Improved stage-input checks, microphone setup guidance, and audience readiness before going live.
Improved account deletion and linked-session cleanup.

versions.summary: This release made project recovery and imported script structure more dependable.
improved: A temporary script lookup failure no longer makes a project appear to have no script; the project can retry while existing data remains available.
Script imports better preserve italic dialogue and explicit stage directions that follow dialogue.

versions.summary: This release introduced a dedicated localized public home and Live entry for Pockitle.
new: Added the localized public Pockitle home and Live experience, with matching navigation, contact and legal pages, installable web metadata, and visual identity.

versions.summary: This release improved recovery guidance, expired-session handling, and imported cue structure.
improved: Operator unlock and password-recovery messages now explain the next step more clearly.
Script analysis better retains typed cue structure in imported documents.
fixed: Expired audience snapshots and retired viewer sessions no longer present stale live content.

versions.summary: This release improved recovery across projects, registration, and resumed live sessions.
improved: Project and registration screens recover more gracefully from temporary data or asset-loading interruptions.
Operators can recover live control more reliably after resuming a session, and retained reports reopen more dependably.

versions.summary: This release improved long-running sessions, audience feedback, and script imports.
improved: Long-running live sessions recover more reliably.
Script imports better retain cast and cue context.
fixed: Audience feedback drafts are preserved after a restart, and feedback can still be submitted after a performance ends.

versions.summary: This release added an optional post-show audience feedback journey and improved report continuity.
new: Added an optional post-show audience survey with clear consent and an end-of-show report journey.
improved: Kept Live Console and audience screens available throughout a performance.
Improved feedback drafts and report history across restarts and earlier sessions.

versions.summary: This release corrected signup and several end-of-performance recovery cases.
improved: Completion and recovery messages are now localized.
fixed: Signup now completes account setup before opening the dashboard.
Shows navigation and performance-end controls recover more reliably.
Pausing a performance now preserves the final caption line.

versions.summary: This release improved first-time setup, simulation launch, and localized workflow guidance.
improved: First-time setup no longer shows a false dashboard failure while account setup is still completing.
Simulation launch now waits for the active project context, avoiding handoff failures during loading.
Localized product copy and workflow guidance are more consistent across supported languages.
fixed: Runtime links and no-content responses now complete cleanly instead of stalling or rendering incorrectly.

versions.summary: This release expanded event-planning guidance and improved public navigation on tablets.
new: Added planning guidance for live captions at conferences, classrooms, panels, and other spoken events.
improved: Expanded translated workflow examples and planning guides across supported locales.
fixed: Restored complete public navigation on tablet-sized layouts.

versions.summary: This release made live-session startup clearer and more resilient.
improved: Microphone-permission errors now provide a clearer recovery path.
fixed: Repeated show-start requests now continue the existing startup attempt instead of creating duplicate session state.

versions.summary: This release improved caption typography across audience and projection views.
improved: Audience and projection captions now use consistent language-aware fonts and honor the selected font size without silently shrinking text.

versions.summary: This release improved the mobile audience monitor across phone layouts.
improved: Current captions, language selection, live status, and viewer count remain readable across supported phone layouts.
Improved language-output continuity when one output is temporarily unavailable.

versions.summary: This release expanded the localized Pockitle experience and refined projection history.
new: Added localized public Pockitle pages and a supported-language catalog.
improved: Public navigation and language menus remain usable on tablets and narrow screens.
Projection preview can show a bounded number of previous captions while keeping the current caption clear.

versions.summary: This release improved repeat-performance preparation, projection controls, and DOCX imports.
improved: Improved preparation for repeat performances and refined projection controls.
fixed: DOCX imports now preserve scene headings and reject oversized or malformed uploads with a clear result.

versions.summary: This release expanded localized discovery and made audience reconnection more consistent.
new: Expanded localized public discovery and event or live-caption guidance.
improved: Audience and live-session state handling now keeps reconnects and accepted captions more consistent.

versions.summary: This release refined live-session control, projection setup, and Editor collaboration.
improved: Refined projection setup with clearer controls, reusable presets, and safer output handling.
Improved Editor saving, history, collaboration, and structural editing reliability.
Expanded script analysis for fragmented, cue-less, and less-structured documents.
A newly opened Live Console remains read-only while another console is active or starting, with an explicit Take Over action.
fixed: Fixed reconnection, state-synchronization, and operator-control issues during live sessions.

versions.summary: This release added organization-level generative AI controls and clearer live-session readiness.
new: Added an organization-wide control for generative AI while keeping standard machine translation available.
improved: Added an audience-readiness check before a live performance starts.

versions.summary: This release expanded the localized Pockitle experience.
new: Added localized Pockitle product pages, language information, and workflow guides.
improved: Improved Pockitle page layouts on narrow screens.

versions.summary: This release introduced Pockitle Live Beta and expanded script and Editor workflows.
new: Introduced the Pockitle Live Web Beta for unscripted live captions and translation, with Audience links, multilingual output rooms, browser projection, and manual caption controls.
Added bulk actions for editing multiple script lines.
improved: Script analysis now supports less-structured documents with fewer or no explicit cues.

versions.summary: This release made manual Editor changes more dependable.
fixed: Fixed an issue that could discard or overwrite manual Editor changes.

versions.summary: This release improved script imports and Editor recovery.
improved: Script imports handle fragmented Word documents and documents with less explicit cues more reliably.
Improved Editor recovery after translation timeouts, preserving edit history and temporary lines.

versions.summary: This release improved live-session synchronization and Editor recovery.
improved: Operator consoles and audience viewers synchronize more reliably after reconnecting or joining a live session.

versions.summary: This release improved QLab output options and live cue recovery.
improved: QLab packs now support safer downloads and re-imports.
Live cue state recovers more reliably when an operator console reconnects or receives an update.

versions.summary: This release made QLab show packs more flexible and reusable.
improved: Added options for routing QLab outputs to the same screen or separate screens.

versions.summary: This release improved QLab pack handling.
improved: Added per-output language options for QLab packs.

versions.summary: This release brought QLab-based surtitles to the web.
new: Introduced beta QLab cue sync for projected surtitles and audience captions, with setup guides for preparing a show.

versions.summary: This release expanded QLab show preparation and audience recovery.
new: Added configurable QLab Projection Packs and offline spreadsheet exports for show preparation.
improved: Audience displays reconnect more reliably after brief interruptions.

versions.summary: This release improved script analysis and localized guidance.
improved: Script analysis better handles dialogue without speaker labels or with names separated from dialogue.
Localized script-check guidance is clearer across supported languages.

versions.summary: This release improved caption continuity and audience feedback recovery.
improved: Audience feedback can be retried after a temporary connection problem.
fixed: Empty live updates no longer replace the current caption.

versions.summary: This release improved live-session recovery.
improved: Live controls and audience views recover more reliably after brief connection interruptions.

versions.summary: This release added a time-limited pass and improved script and audience workflows.
new: Added a Show Week Pass for time-limited access during a production week.
improved: Made it easier for audience members to return to the original language while viewing captions.
fixed: Script analysis now preserves dialogue that follows cast-list material.

versions.summary: This release added QLab export tools for show preparation.
new: Added downloadable QLab cue maps and show-preparation exports.

versions.summary: This release clarified live-session guidance and polished localized guides.
improved: Clarified Go Live guidance and restored media and captions across localized product guides.
fixed: Fixed the display of highlighted pricing-plan cards.

versions.summary: This release added script-review controls and strengthened collaboration.
new: Added an editable cast-review step before script analysis.
improved: Improved script analysis for cast lists, fragmented dialogue, and unclear speaker cues.
fixed: Restored collaborators’ ability to delete their own saved versions.
